headline: Fuel Prices Today Evening, 14/8, Down by 205-493 Dong; E10 Falls Sharply; What About the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra's Price?
summary: The joint Ministry of Industry and Trade and Ministry of Finance announced fuel prices fell across the board in the adjustment effective from the afternoon session on August 13.
why: Domestic fuel prices in Vietnam are set through periodic government adjustments that pass through to transport costs and inflation.
